title: Meta-Fair: AI-Assisted Fairness Testing of Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper includes 'religion' as one of its five primary bias dimensions for evaluating LLMs. It specifically tests and benchmarks model performance using prompts involving various religious identities (e.g., Catholic, Muslim, Hindu, Jewish) and sacred texts (e.g., Bible, Torah, Guru Granth Sahib) to identify religious bias.
